notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

It's been a little bit since my last update, And that's because I've been swamped the past couple weeks and haven't had a lot of time to work on the game. But I'd like to try and keep you all updated on what's happening and how far along the next update is.

Here's a breakdown of what's in the works.
------
> Difficulty Leaderboards
Each difficulty is getting it's own leaderboard. When the new boss patch is released, I'll be clearing the current leaderboards and splitting them into their individual difficulties.

> New Enemies
I've been working on a few new enemies to add new variation during gameplay.
With 3 enemies, there's only so much you can do.

> Customizable Player Portraits
Player Portraits are almost ready to mark off the list for the time being, with 6 different sets of faces that can be mixed and matched, it'll give a lot of variation as it stands for now.
I plan to add more options for customization as the game gets closer to completion.

> Trilo Baro (Fist Boss)
2 of the 3 fazes for the Trilo Baro boss encounter are nearly complete. When the health meter for the boss is empty, it will trigger the next faze and be refilled with it's new amount of HP. This is to help players know just how far through each faze they are.

> New Music
There are some new music tracks being added to the game, one will replace the currently existing placeholder track during gameplay and a couple others for on the title screen and during the encounter with the boss.

> Revamped intro
The short intro sequence before the title screen is being reworked to align with the musical beats, and will also include more visual imagery and lore.
------

As you can see, this next update is a much bigger content update than the previous updates, and will still take a bit more time to complete because of that.

I'm going to start doing weekly updates to help keep you all updated on what's going down, and to help keep myself from losing track of my own update content. Possibly focus more on individual parts to help myself complete updates much faster.

Anyway.
Thank you all so much for the continued support. I really appreciate it.

I'll catch you all in the next update!


> Sterling-ThorneStarr

notes.title: V0.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
V0.0.5 - Patch notes

The entire controller can now be utilized. Instead of only the press buttons being usable, you can now use the thumb sticks as well.

	 Thumb Sticks can now be customized.

notes.title: Update Patch notes
notes.notes:
STARR RINGER
V0.0.4 - Patch notes

Fixes:

	 Fixed fatal crash error caused by a missing variable.


Changes:

	 Left and Right indicators have been added to menus to make menus less confusing.
	 Gamepad Thumbsticks can now be used to control movement. (This can not be customized at this time)


Balancing:

	 Tweaked the duration of I-Frames the player has after getting hit.
		- Decreased from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.

notes.title: Day 1 patch
notes.notes:
STARR RINGER
V0.0.3-b : Day 1 patch.

Changes and Fixes:

	 Fixed a bug where the game window would start almost entirely off screen when first loading the game.
	 Cosmic Ray weapon level 4 has been disabled until it can be fixed.
	 fixed a bug where you could start and restart the score uploading sequence by pressing the input key/button before the score upload timer was complete.
	 Weapons now revert by only 1 level instead of reverting back to level 1 when collecting a new type of weapon.

Planned for next patch:

	 Make thumb sticks function by default on gamepad.
	 update the Cosmic Ray Weapon to have a functional weapon level 4.
	 add player stats UI during game play.

notes.title: Slight delay on release
notes.notes:
While I wish I could have released STARR RINGER today, I unfortunately was greeted this morning to some ugly bugs showed up and I really don't want to have my first indie game release with system breaking bugs. It wouldn't be a very good look.

But, do not fret, STARR RINGER will be releasing. And when it releases, it will also have a really awesome trailer to boot!

Thanks for your patience, as I somewhat fumble my way through the process of releasing my first game on steam.

- Sterling McKay
> Programmer, Writer, Designer, and Artist.
